push_subscription_web_keys.name: push_subscription_web_keys
push_subscription_web_keys.value: "push_subscription"."platform" <> 'web' or ("push_subscription"."p256dh" is not null and "push_subscription"."auth" is not null)

offering_at_lister_has_area.name: offering_at_lister_has_area
offering_at_lister_has_area.value: not ('at_lister' = any("offering"."handovers")) or "offering"."area" is not null

offering_elsewhere_has_place.name: offering_elsewhere_has_place
offering_elsewhere_has_place.value: not ('elsewhere' = any("offering"."handovers")) or "offering"."meeting_place" is not null

offering_positive_numbers.name: offering_positive_numbers
offering_positive_numbers.value:
("offering"."amount" is null or "offering"."amount" > 0) and ("offering"."remaining" is null or "offering"."remaining" >= 0)
      and ("offering"."loan_length" is null or "offering"."loan_length" > 0)
      and ("offering"."session_length" is null or "offering"."session_length" > 0)
      and ("offering"."sessions_available" is null or "offering"."sessions_available" >= 1)
      and ("offering"."sessions_remaining" is null or "offering"."sessions_remaining" >= 0)

offering_units_with_numbers.name: offering_units_with_numbers
offering_units_with_numbers.value:
("offering"."amount" is null) = ("offering"."unit" is null)
      and ("offering"."loan_length" is null) = ("offering"."loan_length_unit" is null)
      and ("offering"."session_length" is null) = ("offering"."session_length_unit" is null)

offering_fields_match_type.name: offering_fields_match_type
offering_fields_match_type.value:
("offering"."type" = 'lend' or ("offering"."loan_length" is null))
      and ("offering"."type" = 'service' or ("offering"."session_length" is null and "offering"."sessions_available" is null and "offering"."sessions_remaining" is null))
      and ("offering"."type" <> 'service' or ("offering"."amount" is null))
      and ("offering"."type" in ('gift', 'trade') or "offering"."remaining" is null)

trade_accept_amount.name: trade_accept_amount
trade_accept_amount.value: ("trade_accept"."amount" is null or "trade_accept"."amount" > 0) and ("trade_accept"."amount" is null) = ("trade_accept"."unit" is null)

generated.as: case when "loan_starts_at" is null then null else tstzrange("loan_starts_at", "loan_ends_at") end

arrangement_positive_numbers.name: arrangement_positive_numbers
arrangement_positive_numbers.value:
("arrangement"."loan_length" is null or "arrangement"."loan_length" > 0) and ("arrangement"."amount" is null or "arrangement"."amount" > 0)
      and ("arrangement"."own_offer_amount" is null or "arrangement"."own_offer_amount" > 0)
      and ("arrangement"."session_length" is null or "arrangement"."session_length" > 0) and ("arrangement"."sessions" is null or "arrangement"."sessions" >= 1)

arrangement_units_with_numbers.name: arrangement_units_with_numbers
arrangement_units_with_numbers.value:
("arrangement"."loan_length" is null) = ("arrangement"."loan_length_unit" is null)
      and ("arrangement"."session_length" is null) = ("arrangement"."session_length_unit" is null)
      and ("arrangement"."own_offer_amount" is null) = ("arrangement"."own_offer_unit" is null)

arrangement_text_lengths.name: arrangement_text_lengths
arrangement_text_lengths.value:
("arrangement"."own_offer" is null or char_length("arrangement"."own_offer") <= 300)
      and ("arrangement"."decision_note" is null or char_length("arrangement"."decision_note") <= 500)

arrangement_record_only_when_agreed.name: arrangement_record_only_when_agreed
arrangement_record_only_when_agreed.value:
"arrangement"."status" = 'agreed' or ("arrangement"."agreed_place" is null and "arrangement"."agreed_offer" is null and "arrangement"."loan_starts_at" is null
      and "arrangement"."loan_ends_at" is null and "arrangement"."returned_at" is null and "arrangement"."reminder_sent_at" is null and "arrangement"."done_at" is null)

arrangement_loan_period.name: arrangement_loan_period
arrangement_loan_period.value: ("arrangement"."loan_starts_at" is null) = ("arrangement"."loan_ends_at" is null) and ("arrangement"."loan_starts_at" is null or "arrangement"."loan_starts_at" < "arrangement"."loan_ends_at")

arrangement_returned_is_a_loan.name: arrangement_returned_is_a_loan
arrangement_returned_is_a_loan.value: "arrangement"."returned_at" is null or "arrangement"."loan_starts_at" is not null

request_dates_in_order.name: request_dates_in_order
request_dates_in_order.value: "request"."needed_after" is null or "request"."needed_by" is null or "request"."needed_by" >= "request"."needed_after"

request_positive_numbers.name: request_positive_numbers
request_positive_numbers.value:
("request"."amount" is null or "request"."amount" > 0) and ("request"."loan_length" is null or "request"."loan_length" > 0)
      and ("request"."session_length" is null or "request"."session_length" > 0) and ("request"."sessions" is null or "request"."sessions" >= 1)

request_units_with_numbers.name: request_units_with_numbers
request_units_with_numbers.value:
("request"."amount" is null) = ("request"."unit" is null)
      and ("request"."loan_length" is null) = ("request"."loan_length_unit" is null)
      and ("request"."session_length" is null) = ("request"."session_length_unit" is null)

request_fields_match_kind.name: request_fields_match_kind
request_fields_match_kind.value:
("request"."kind" = 'borrow' or "request"."loan_length" is null)
      and ("request"."kind" in ('receive', 'trade') or "request"."amount" is null)
      and ("request"."kind" = 'service' or ("request"."session_length" is null and "request"."sessions" is null))

request_give_back_amount.name: request_give_back_amount
request_give_back_amount.value: ("request_give_back"."amount" is null or "request_give_back"."amount" > 0) and ("request_give_back"."amount" is null) = ("request_give_back"."unit" is null)

public_message_body_length.name: public_message_body_length
public_message_body_length.value: "public_message"."removed_at" is not null or char_length("public_message"."body") between 1 and 240
